title: Placement Test Reset
scenario: A message says your language placement result can be reset for a fee.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Placement Test Reset: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Academic records cannot be changed through private payments.
